inputs.name: loadUnits.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to resolve the source tree and registry paths for this load. Defaults to process.cwd(); resolve() turns it into an absolute path.

inputs.name: loadUnits.tree
inputs.description: Optional readable source snapshot used instead of a WorkingTreeAdapter created from root; it must provide revision, list(), and read(path). Defaults to undefined, so the working tree is used.

inputs.name: loadUnits.indexer
inputs.description: Service that indexes the selected source tree with the loaded UnitsConfig before registry reconciliation. Defaults to new SourceIndexService(); the supplied instance must provide index(source, config).

inputs.name: graphOf.loaded
inputs.description: Loaded snapshot supplying the source index, stored manifests, and scenarios used to build the graph. It must be a LoadedUnits value, including its UnitRegistryRepository instance.

inputs.name: graphOf.manifests
inputs.description: Manifest list used for graph ownership and dependencies when provided. Defaults to loaded.stored.

outputs.name: loadUnits
outputs.description: Promise that resolves to the absolute root, loaded config and source index, stored manifests and scenarios, indexing result, workflow errors, unformatted ids, and registry repository. The complete value contains a UnitRegistryRepository instance and is not expressible as JSON.

outputs.name: graphOf
outputs.description: Graph built from the loaded source index, selected manifests, and loaded scenarios. It contains graph nodes, edges, and uncertain source references for the indexed snapshot.

errors.name: Source tree, registry, scenario, or index read failure
errors.description: The returned promise rejects if a source-tree, registry, scenario, or indexing call rejects; loadUnits propagates the rejection without catching or translating it.

inputs.name: loadUnits.root
inputs.description: The repository root that loadUnits resolves to an absolute path before creating the registry repositories and selecting a working-tree source. It matters when loading a repository other than the process working directory; omission uses process.cwd().

inputs.name: loadUnits.tree
inputs.description: The optional source snapshot passed to configuration, indexing, registry, and scenario reads. When omitted, loadUnits creates a WorkingTreeAdapter for the resolved root.

inputs.name: loadUnits.indexer
inputs.description: The source index service called with the selected source tree and loaded units config to produce the source index used for the fresh unit index. When omitted, loadUnits creates a SourceIndexService.

outputs.name: loadUnits
outputs.description: A promise resolving to the absolute root, config, source index, stored manifests, scenarios, collected workflow errors, unformatted ids, fresh unit-index result, and registry repository. Callers use it to inspect the loaded state; its repository field is a class instance.

errors.name: Source tree, registry, scenario, or index read failure
errors.description: The returned promise rejects if a source-tree, registry, scenario, or indexing call rejects; loadUnits propagates the rejection without catching or translating it.

inputs.name: graphOf.loaded
inputs.description: The loaded snapshot whose index and scenarios are passed to SourceGraphService.build, and whose stored manifests are used when no explicit manifests are supplied. It matters whenever a graph is built from a loadUnits result.

inputs.name: graphOf.manifests
inputs.description: The manifest list passed to SourceGraphService.build in place of the snapshot's stored manifests. When omitted, the default is loaded.stored; the loaded index and scenarios still come from loaded.

outputs.name: graphOf
outputs.description: The SourceGraph returned synchronously from the loaded index, selected manifests, and loaded scenarios. Callers use it to inspect source relationships for that loaded snapshot.
